episodes.title: Droid Destruction, What We Know So Far
episodes.description: In Episode 17 of Holotable Chaos, Jonny and Gavin give their early reactions to the announcement, talk through the information that’s been revealed, and speculate on what the new raid could mean for the game. Since this is an almost immediate reaction to the announcement, some details could change as more information comes out.
episodes.summary: Jonny and Gavin react to the Droid Destruction announcement and discuss what the new raid could mean for the game.

episodes.title: The GAC Guide, How to Approach Grand Arena
episodes.description: Grand Arena can be one of the most complicated parts of Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, but having a game plan can make all the difference. In Episode 16 of Holotable Chaos, Jonny and Gavin break down how they approach GAC, from setting defenses and scouting your opponent to managing GAC resources, choosing a side, and making your attacks. Plus, the most important part of any GAC round: hoping your defense does good.
episodes.summary: Jonny and Gavin share their GAC approach, from scouting and setting defenses to managing resources and making attacks.

episodes.title: Embo & Keibu, Are They Built For Baylan Skoll
episodes.description: Embo & Keibu are here! We break down their kit, talk about where they could fit, and explore Jonny’s theory that they might be built to work with Baylan Skoll.
episodes.summary: A look at Embo & Keibu’s kit, where they might fit, and whether they could be built to work with Baylan Skoll.

episodes.title: SWGoH This or That
episodes.description: This week on Holotable Chaos, Jonny goes solo for a round of SWGoH This or That! We also cover the latest game events, farming plans, roster review, and more.
episodes.summary: Jonny plays a round of SWGoH This or That, with updates on game events, farming plans, and a roster review.

episodes.title: Interview With theothersean!
episodes.description: In Episode 13 of Holotable Chaos, we’re joined by theothersean, the former host of Galactic War Report and a longtime member of the SWGOH community! We talk about his journey through SWGOH, Galactic War Report, how the game has changed, the new eras, roster advice, and more.
episodes.summary: The former Galactic War Report host joins the show to talk about his SWGoH journey, the game's changes, current eras, and roster advice.

episodes.title: Ships 101, Stop Ignoring Fleets
episodes.description: Ships are one of the most important parts of your roster in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes—but they’re also one of the easiest things to ignore. In Episode 12 of Holotable Chaos, Jonny and Gavin break down why you shouldn’t sleep on ships, what makes them so important, and where you should start when building your fleet roster. Whether you’re new to the game or have been putting off your ship farms for way too long, we’ve got you covered.
episodes.summary: Jonny and Gavin discuss why ships matter, what makes fleets valuable, and how to get started building a fleet roster.

episodes.title: Your First Galactic Legend, Which One Should You Choose
episodes.description: Your first Galactic Legend is a huge decision in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes—but which one should you choose? In Episode 11 of Holotable Chaos, Jonny and Gavin break down the different things you should consider when choosing your first GL. We also dive into the Anniversary LSTs, Renewal Quests, and what the future could look like once the Anniversary LSTs disappear after November.
episodes.summary: Jonny and Gavin weigh the choices for a first Galactic Legend and discuss Anniversary LSTs, Renewal Quests, and what comes next.

episodes.title: Mara Jade Skywalker is No Joke, Breaking Down Her Kit & More
episodes.description: Mara Jade Skywalker has arrived in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes, and she’s already making an impact. This week, Jonny breaks down Mara Jade’s kit, talks about the latest in-game events, and shares what he’s currently farming and working toward. No Gavin this week, but we’ll be back to our usual chaos soon. As always, nothing ever goes to plan.
episodes.summary: Jonny reviews Mara Jade Skywalker's kit, covers current in-game events, and talks through his farming plans.

episodes.title: Legends Are Finally Here! Breaking Down the Era of Myths and Legends
episodes.description: The Era of Myths & Legends has officially arrived in Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes! In this episode of Holotable Chaos, we break down every new character announcement, including Darth Jar Jar, Mara Jade Skywalker, Dark Side Vision Yoda, Starkiller Luke, and more. We also discuss GL Mando & Grogu, share our current farming progress, cover Grand Arena and Conquest, and talk about why this might be one of the most exciting eras SWGoH has ever introduced. Join us as we break down everything coming in the Era of Myths & Legends and what it means for the future of SWGoH!
episodes.summary: The hosts review the Myths and Legends announcements, their farming progress, and the era's impact on Grand Arena and Conquest.
